item.title: Stranger Than Heaven: A Grounded Spin‑Off of Like A Dragon
item.description: Explore Sega’s new Like A Dragon spin‑off, Stranger Than Heaven, with a deep, character‑driven narrative, advanced combat, and a semi‑open world. The game spans five decades of 1960s Shinjuku, featuring a complex arm‑controlled combat system, celebrity cameos, and a raw look at racial prejudice.
